stemMd: An investment earns simple interest at 6% per year. After 3 years its total value is 2360 units. What was the principal?
explanationMd: Simple interest adds 3 times 6%=18% of principal. Therefore 1.18P=2360 and P=2000. Interest is 360, confirming the total.

distractorRationale.b: A principal of 1980 earns 356.40 over three years and totals 2336.40, below the stated 2360. Reverse the 1.18 multiplier instead.
distractorRationale.a: This does not produce the stated total.
distractorRationale.d: This reverses only one year's interest.
